summary: Stale Revision: origin/master is df2f64061d669861e46d91655e2b1da15f1219a7 and is not an ancestor of f663801927e2f71420041f88b55be69b1d8b03b8 (git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 1), so it cannot fast-forward. The missing commit is cli: refuse flag tokens as values for value-taking flags; this SHA lacks looksLikeFlagToken and its regression tests, so merging would drop current master behavior where --root/--after/--limit/--agent/--exit/--since/--rejected refuse a following flag token as a value. The branch's own help-arity fix is narrow and its test passes, but it must be rebased onto current origin/master (df2f640) and re-reviewed with the flag-value refusal preserved before approval.
